appliedUpdates.description: Added LongCoT vendor data quirk (logic domain null answers) to .factory/library/quality-tooling.md.
Added module registry test isolation pattern (_reset_registry usage) to .factory/library/quality-tooling.md.
Added canonical per-module optimization entrypoint pattern to .factory/library/quality-tooling.md.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the 'Known Pre-Existing Issues' section to remove or rephrase the 'Empty module registry' note. Commit 3645c9a1 populated _MODULE_ENTRYPOINTS with 'fleet_rlm.runtime.quality.optimize_longcot', so the registry is no longer empty.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature longcot-module-registration (commit 3645c9a1) correctly populates _MODULE_ENTRYPOINTS. AGENTS.md line 251 still lists it as a pre-existing issue.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the canonical per-module optimization entrypoint pattern (lazy DSPy imports inside factory functions, module-level register_module() call, add to _MODULE_ENTRYPOINTS, comprehensive unit tests) so future module authors follow it consistently.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviewer for longcot-module-registration noted the commit demonstrates a good pattern. Future milestones may add more optimizable modules (e.g., additional reasoner variants).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance on subprocess-based tests in the unit test suite — when they are acceptable versus when tests should be placed under tests/integration/. The test_longcot_dataset.py fixture runs a dataset generation script via subprocess for every dependent test, which is acceptable for a generation script but may not scale for heavier generators.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature longcot-module-tests reviewer flagged that AGENTS.md provides no guidance on subprocess thresholds in unit tests.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Note fleet_rlm.cli.fleet_cli's import of optimize_command at module level as a good example of the 'no import-time side effects' rule: the CLI entrypoint imports the command module, but optimize_cmd.py defers module_registry imports until runtime inside the command function.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature longcot-module-tests reviewer identified this as a pattern worth emulating for new CLI commands.

rejectedObservations.observation: Consider adding a CI check or pre-commit hook that flags changes to runtime/agent/signatures.py when runtime/models/builders.py is not modified in tandem.
The VAL-MOD-* labeling convention used in commit messages and test docstrings should be standardized in AGENTS.md.
